subject.title: Rescue: add watchdog core service and cron engine

question: Should OpenClaw core land this built-in rescue watchdog cron and repair service now, and what recovery authority plus real-host proof are required before merge?
rationale: The PR adds core service-control and doctor repair behavior that can restart or repair local Gateway profiles, so the default authority, proof bar, and security boundary need human ownership beyond mechanical rebase fixes.

options.title: Rebase then require proof
options.body: Port the watchdog onto current cron protocol, SQLite, and command-job architecture, then require redacted real-host recovery proof before merge.

options.title: Pause for design sponsorship
options.body: Keep the PR open but paused until a maintainer-owned design for core recovery authority and operator opt-in semantics is recorded.

options.title: Close in favor of umbrella design
options.body: Close this implementation PR if maintainers decide the current branch is too stale or broad and want #36314 split into fresh smaller slices.

recommendation.title: Rebase then require proof
recommendation.body: Port the watchdog onto current cron protocol, SQLite, and command-job architecture, then require redacted real-host recovery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical watchdog issue already routes the product/security decision through steipete, and adjacent Gateway resilience history makes him the best available decision owner.
